decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly burn through your opponent's life total by playing cheap and efficient burn spells, while also utilizing aggressive creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear to pressure your opponent and close out the game before they can stabilize. The deck prioritizes dealing direct damage to the opponent's face and aims to be fast and proactive, punishing slow or clunky decks. The mana base is streamlined to ensure consistent access to the deck's powerful burn spells and creatures.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. The deck includes powerful early-game threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief, backed up by disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker. Feign Death and Undying Malice provide additional value by reusing creatures or creating extra tokens. The inclusion of burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate gives the deck the tools needed to finish off the opponent quickly and efficiently.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly develop a board presence with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting the opponent's game plan with Counterspells and removal like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt. The deck also aims to generate card advantage through cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. The mana base is optimized for consistency and efficiency, with fetch lands like Misty Rainforest and Scalding Tarn. Overall, the deck focuses on a fast-paced, proactive strategy to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Titan of Industry. It also utilizes Wrenn and Six to recur lands and generate card advantage. The combination of these cards creates a powerful combo strategy that can overwhelm opponents quickly. The deck also includes cards like Thoughtseize and Bitter Reunion to disrupt the opponent's game plan and control the board. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces and win the game before the opponent can respond effectively.

This deck focuses on aggressively utilizing powerful creature and burn spells to quickly pressure and disrupt the opponent. By combining efficient threats like Lightning Skelemental, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger with strong disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, the deck looks to overwhelm the opponent early on and maintain pressure throughout the game. Additionally, cards like Unearth and Seasoned Pyromancer provide card advantage and additional threats, ensuring a steady stream of pressure and disruption. The deck aims to close out games quickly and decisively.

This deck revolves around assembling the "Hammer Time" combo, utilizing equipment like Colossus Hammer and Shadowspear to quickly equip creatures like Ornithopter and Inkmoth Nexus for powerful, evasive attacks. The deck aims to maximize card draw and efficiency with Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid, while also utilizing Stoneforge Mystic to tutor for key pieces. Additionally, Urza's Saga provides additional utility and card advantage. Overall, the deck focuses on quickly assembling its combo pieces and overwhelming opponents with powerful, synergistic plays.

This deck revolves around using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker by sacrificing tokens generated from Dwarven Mine. Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce provide protection while Wrenn and Six helps with card advantage and land recursion. The deck also includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt, Prismatic Ending, and Prismari Command. Expressive Iteration helps dig for key pieces while Leyline Binding prevents opponents from disrupting the combo. Xander's Lounge can provide additional value by copying key spells or abilities.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to use a combination of board control and targeted removal to disrupt and dismantle the opponent's game plan. The deck utilizes cards like Damnation and Fatal Push to clear the opponent's creatures, while also using cards like Bloodchief's Thirst and Invoke Despair to remove specific threats. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Relic of Progenitus and Field of Ruin to disrupt the opponent's graveyard and mana base respectively. The deck also features heavy card draw with Night's Whisper and Profane Tutor to ensure consistent access to its powerful spells.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategies while utilizing the mechanic of blinking to gain additional value from enters-the-battlefield effects. The deck includes efficient creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Stoneforge Mystic, as well as disruption elements like Leonin Arbiter and Archon of Emeria. Aether Vial and Giver of Runes help protect key creatures, while cards like Solitude provide removal options. The deck also includes equipment like Sword of Fire and Ice and Kaldra Compleat to further enhance the aggro strategy. The combination of aggressive creatures and blinking effects make this deck a versatile and powerful option in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield quickly. It also includes Leyline Binding to disrupt opponents' strategies and protect its own win conditions. Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce provide additional control elements, while Wrenn and Six help with card advantage and mana fixing. The deck aims to be versatile and creative in its combo plays, utilizing a mix of spells and creatures to overwhelm opponents and secure victory.

The focus of this deck is to quickly mill the opponent's deck by utilizing cards that force them to mill cards whenever possible. The main strategy involves using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Archive Trap to quickly mill the opponent's deck, while also using counterspells and removal to disrupt their game plan. Additionally, cards like Visions of Beyond and Fractured Sanity provide card advantage and further accelerate the milling process. Jace, the Perfected Mind serves as both a win condition and a way to control the opponent's deck even further.

The deck focuses on casting cheap Cascade spells like Violent Outburst to cheat out powerful 0-cost spells, such as Crashing Footfalls and Dead / Gone. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle while also gaining value from Cascade triggers. The deck includes versatile cards like Shardless Agent, Brazen Borrower, and Seasoned Pyromancer to control the board and maintain pressure. The inclusion of cards like Force of Negation and Boseiju, Who Endures helps to protect key spells and ensure the deck's strategy goes off smoothly.
